icp_classification.rationale: High-growth software company scaling outbound enterprise GTM; fits all primary ICP criteria with rich product and hiring signals.
matched_criteria: Scaling sales team (>500 employees, rapid ARR expansion)

brief.executive_summary: Notion is a connected workspace where teams create docs, manage projects, and organize knowledge, now augmented with native AI capabilities.
key_products_or_services: Notion AI (Q&A, automated writing, and autofill database properties)
Project management and agile sprint tracking
likely_pain_points: Enterprise sales reps spending 45+ minutes manually parsing company knowledge before outbound calls
Risk of reps relying on unverified AI summaries that fabricate account facts or metrics in client emails
Inconsistent qualification across growing SDR cohorts when ramping into enterprise accounts
suggested_talk_tracks: Show how verified GTM Copilot dossiers audit every claim against live sources so reps never hallucinate
Highlight automated 2-minute pre-call intelligence generation mapped directly to sales battlecards
Share how sales engineering and account executives achieve 100% grounded outreach sequences
objection_handling_notes: Objection: 'We already use ChatGPT / Notion AI for writing emails.' -> Response: 'Generic LLMs generate ungrounded claims with made-up stats. GTM Copilot audits every single sentence against cited sources and flags hallucinations before sending.'
Objection: 'Our reps already have ZoomInfo.' -> Response: 'ZoomInfo provides static contact data; GTM Copilot conducts live web intelligence synthesis and generates audited talk tracks in seconds.'
